title: Added and removed slide shapes are omitted from the shapesChanged summary

evidence.quote:
const shapeChanges = diffShapes(old.slide.shapes, slide.shapes);
summary.shapesChanged += shapeChanges.length;

reasoning: `summary.shapesChanged` is incremented only for slides present in both decks. The added-slide and removed-slide branches still emit one `ShapeChange` per shape, but they never add those emitted changes to the summary. A deck with one new slide containing two shapes therefore reports `shapesChanged: 0` while `slideChanges` contains two added shape changes, making the public summary inconsistent with the detailed diff.
recommendation: Increment `summary.shapesChanged` by `slide.shapes.length` in the added and removed slide branches, or rename/document the field as only counting shape changes within matched slides. Prefer keeping it equal to the total emitted shape changes for non-unchanged slides.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The linked `packages/core/test/diff.test.ts` file covers paragraph text diff behavior and does not assert slide summary accounting for added or removed slides.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a slides diff test with one added slide containing two shapes and one removed slide containing one shape; assert `summary.shapesChanged === 3` and matches the total emitted shape changes.
minimumFixScope: Update `packages/core/src/diff/slides.ts` summary accounting in the added and removed slide branches and add a focused regression test.
